claim: Pause, resume and end on an order's recurrence (POST /procurement/orders/:id/recurrence/pause, /resume, /end), a set on an order that already carries a rule, and a first rule on an order whose created_by is not the caller all call OrganizationsService.assertCanManageRestaurant through OrderRecurrenceService.assertMayChangeARule before anything is written, so a caller whose role at the house is not owner or manager, or cannot be read, gets 403 and nothing is written; the helper missing answers 500. A first rule on one's own order (created_by is the caller, read through RECURRENCE_SELECT) asks no role, and its write is conditioned on recurrence_status IS NULL (409 rule_set_meanwhile otherwise). At c4fe6a68b the four routes carried only the class JwtAuthGuard.
